records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Willow Partners!
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Great to hear things are going well -- thanks for the reply. A walkthrough is easy to arrange: would a short call this week work? I'm happy to work around your calendar.

If it's useful, we can spend it on getting the rest of the team in alongside your first project -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the natural next step.

Best,
Chidi
